rca of the issue: parity-heatmap: 'chartLegend is not defined' — a variable/import missing in ParityHeatmap component (likely `Legend` was renamed but a stray `chartLegend` identifier remains). branding: separate ReferenceError (ref ERR-TIBDU7AQ — need to check /var/log or console during click to capture the actual message). analytics/notification-settings/templates/integrations: their `id`s are defined in menuSections but there is no corresponding case in App.js's activeView renderer switch, so main<> renders nothing (or keeps prior render for templates/integrations where they land after a previously-rendered view).
